messages.subject: Javascript error - segmentation fault and core dumped.
parts:
I built a simple app for the Coursera Developing Data Products course.  I saw Javascript errors a couple of times before, but on Sunday I couldn't get a single error, no matter how many times myself or other people tried. 

Yesterday evening and today this issue reappeared. Very frustrating because the peer review period just started and its' too late to do anything about it now.  URL is https://pjchamberlain.shinyapps.io/devdataprod/ 

Error message ends with segmentation fault, core dumped - full message from the Javascript console below. Did I do something wrong or is this on the server side?
